definitions.explanation: Any of the twelve pairs of nerves that emerge directly from the brain (rather than the spinal cord). They control functions such as sight, hearing, smell, facial movement, and swallowing.
A general term referring to the brain and nervous system as a combined field, often used in medical department names and specializations.

examples.japanese: {脳神経|のうしんけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧12⟦{対|つい}→対：00411_tsui⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are twelve pairs of cranial nerves in total.

examples.japanese: {脳神経|のうしんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: An abnormality was found in the cranial nerve examination.

examples.japanese: {三叉|さんさ}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧5{脳神経|のうしんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかさどって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The trigeminal nerve is the fifth cranial nerve and controls facial sensation.

{脳神経|のうしんけい}{内科|ないか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}→脳卒中：04647_nousocchuu⟧や⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{診|み}る→診る：09798_miru⟧。

examples.english: Since my headaches are severe, I decided to get a detailed examination at the neurosurgery department.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧ (brain) + ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerve). Has two distinct but related uses: as a specific anatomical term for the 12 cranial nerves, and as a general term for the brain-and-nerve medical field.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脳神経|のうしんけい}{外科|げか}: neurosurgery
- {脳神経|のうしんけい}{内科|ないか}: neurology (internal medicine)
- {脳神経|のうしんけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: cranial nerve examination
- ⟦{末梢|まっしょう}→末梢：22865_masshou⟧{脳神経|のうしんけい}: peripheral cranial nerve

THE 12 CRANIAL NERVES:
In medical study, the 12 pairs are numbered with Roman numerals (I-XII). Key ones include:
- ⟦{視|し}{神経|しんけい}→視神経：30172_shishinkei⟧ (II): optic nerve
- {三叉|さんさ}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (V): trigeminal nerve
- ⟦{顔面|がんめん}→顔面：14693_ganmen⟧⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (VII): facial nerve
- ⟦{迷走|めいそう}{神経|しんけい}→迷走神経：30156_meisoushinkei⟧ (X): vagus nerve
